first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, so simplifying onboarding directly targets both current problems. The inherited evidence supports gains in completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation. A standard experiment should test the intervention while monitoring qualified revenue and downstream account quality rather than treating activation alone as the objective.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding-shortening experiment this week because completion and activation are both declining, and the verified record shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and a 3% retention lift. Do not broadly replicate signup-field reduction: although it lifted SMB activation and qualified revenue, it also reduced 30-day retention by 1% and did not generalize beyond SMB. Evaluate qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation before scaling.
